title: Cadet Site Engineer
bullets: Kick-start your engineering career with a growing civil contractor
Gain real project experience while completing your degree
Clear pathway for development and career progression
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as an Engineering Cadet?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
content_text:
Menai Civil Contractors is a dynamic and diverse civil construction company committed to delivering quality across every aspect of our business, from project execution to the environment we create for our people. We are passionate about fostering a supportive workplace that encourages growth, development, and long-term career opportunities for all team members.
We are currently seeking a motivated Cadet Engineer to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone currently studying Civil Engineering who is looking to gain practical, hands-on experience within the civil construction industry while completing their degree.
Working alongside experienced Project Managers, Engineers and site teams, you will gain exposure to a diverse range of civil construction projects and develop the practical skills and knowledge to support your future career in engineering.
Key Responsibilities
- Work alongside Project Managers and Engineers to support the day-to-day delivery of civil construction projects.
- Assist with site activities including inspections, quality assurance, measurements and progress tracking.
- Prepare and maintain project documentation, including ITPs, inspection records, reports and other project records.
- Coordinate with Supervisors, subcontractors and suppliers to support project requirements.
- Contribute to project planning, programming and the monitoring of key milestones.
- Assist with WHS, environmental and quality requirements across project sites.
- Gain exposure to the technical, commercial and operational aspects of delivering civil construction projects.
About You
To succeed in this role, you will:
- Be currently studying a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Have a genuine interest in building a career within the civil construction industry.
- Be eager to learn and develop your practical engineering knowledge.
- Have strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Be organised, reliable and able to manage competing priorities.
- Have good attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Be comfortable working across both site and office environments.
- Hold a current Australian driver's licence.
What We Offer
- Hands-on experience across a diverse range of civil construction projects.
- Mentoring and support from experienced Project Managers and Engineers.
- Flexibility to support you while completing your university studies.
- Ongoing learning and development with opportunities for career progression following graduation.
- A supportive and collaborative team culture.
- Competitive remuneration.
If you’re ready to take the next step in your engineering career and grow with Menai Civil, apply now – we’d love to hear from you!
